test_case.test_name: TXWAFL CCD UCE containment and compute recovery
test_case.purpose: At each approved CCD TXWAFL path, inject one authoritative UCE, verify the signed containment/reset and fresh die-specific evidence, then restore all cores, NUMA/memory and fabric health.
required_package: Vendor socket/CCD/core/NUMA/TXWAFL topology and link/location mapping
OOB boot/reimage, compute/fabric recovery and exact rollback
test_case.test_command: Do not assume link0/location1. After approval, bind one enumerated TXWAFL path to the exact CCD, capture raw state and CPU/NUMA/MCA baseline, execute one authorized UCE once under OOB capture, correlate fresh die evidence and containment/reset, then restore and validate cores, memory, NUMA and fabric.
test_case.expected_result: The intended CCD records the approved UCE and containment/reset branch; fresh durable fields identify that die; all expected cores/NUMA nodes return online, MCA stays clean, bounded memory/compute succeeds and settings equal baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until severity and tuple semantics are authoritative. Tool PASS, generic logs, guessed/duplicate CCD, stale record, unexpected reset, missing cores/NUMA, new MCA/memory error or incomplete restoration fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated SUT with independent OOB and quiesced compute/memory workloads.
Abort on wrong die/source, boot loop, missing compute resources, MCA growth or memory/fabric error.
expected_evidence: CCD/core/NUMA/TXWAFL topology and vendor tuple contract
test_case.recovery: Cover containment/reset variants, boot/reimage, offline core/NUMA and memory/fabric restoration plus exact threshold/BIOS/HDT rollback. Execution remains blocked until approved.
